name: agent-guide-drift-check
body:
Agent-guide drift self-test: a build/test-time self-test fails when either embedded guide (the deck `AGENTS.md`, agent-authoring, or the library `AGENTS.md`, library-agent-guide) drifts from the format the code implements. Modeled on the package-init self-test `validateSeed()` in internal/scaffold/helloseed.go (which panics at package load when the embedded hello seed stops loading), coverage is defined PER GUIDE so the test never demands from a guide a token its declared scope does not own. It asserts both a union check (every format token appears in at least one guide) and per-guide scope checks (each guide carries the tokens its scope owns), and that the guides' example snippets still load/validate. It runs in the build/test gate, not at runtime in a user's project, so it cannot be defeated by editing a scaffolded `AGENTS.md`.

Union check — every token the implemented format defines must appear in AT LEAST ONE of the two guides:
- every field type (field-types); the reserved names `deck`/`slide`/`item`/`raw`/`data` and `notes`/`body`/`_format`; the helpers `media`, `section`, `dict`, `list` (template-language, section-helper, dict-list-helpers); the reserved `media:` URL prefix by which theme CSS (and any CSS it imports) references the library's shared `media/` tree, and the reserved `theme:<name>/` URL prefix by which it references another theme's files, both valid for `url()` and `@import` (theme-media-references); the reserved context keys (`.deck.title`/`.deck.author`/`.deck.date`/`.deck.properties`/`.slide.number`/`.slide.total`/`.item.*`/`.raw.*`/`.data.*` — template-context, item-context, raw-source-context, section-data-context, deck-data-in-templates); every `template.yaml` top-level key (`description`, `fields`, `sections`) and body mode (template-manifest, body-rules); and the `library.yaml` keys (`name`, `description`, `format`).
- A format token documented in NEITHER guide fails the self-test.

Per-guide scope check — the tokens a guide's declared scope owns must appear in that guide:
- the deck guide (agent-authoring) must carry every `kalide.yaml` key (`title`, `author`, `date`, `theme`, `navigation`, `properties`, `templates`) and the full CLI command set (`init`, `init-library`, `start`, `templates`, `templates <name>`, `version`), in addition to the shared format tokens it documents (deck layout, slide files and frontmatter, sections and speaker notes, the `templates/` layout, the `template.yaml` schema, the layout language/helpers and context, themes and media rules including the reserved `media:` and `theme:<name>/` theme-CSS prefixes, validation and error reporting);
- the library guide (library-agent-guide) must carry the `templates/` library layout (`library.yaml`, `slides/<name>/`, `sections/<name>/`, `themes/<name>/`, `media/`), the `library.yaml` keys (`name`, `description`, `format`), the `template.yaml` schema and body modes, the layout language, the helper set (`media`, `section`, `dict`, `list`), the reserved names (`deck`/`slide`/`item`/`raw`/`data`), the reserved context keys (`.deck`, `.slide`, `.item`, `.raw`, `.data`), every field type, and themes and media rules including the reserved `media:` and `theme:<name>/` theme-CSS prefixes.
- The library guide's scope excludes the `kalide.yaml` config keys and the `init`/`version` CLI reference: the self-test treats those as outside the library guide's scope, so their presence there is not required and their absence must not fail it. The library guide is not a duplicate of the deck guide's config/CLI reference.

AC:
- removing a guide-scoped token from the guide whose scope owns it (a `kalide.yaml` key or a CLI command from the deck guide; a `library.yaml` key or the library layout from the library guide) makes the self-test fail;
- removing a shared format token (e.g. a field type, one of the `media`/`section`/`dict`/`list` helpers, one of the reserved `deck`/`slide`/`item`/`raw`/`data` names, or either reserved theme-CSS prefix — `media:` or `theme:<name>/`) from BOTH guides, or adding a format token the union of the two guides omits, makes the self-test fail;
- a token intentionally outside one guide's scope (the `kalide.yaml` keys or the `init`/`version` CLI for the library guide) is not required there, and its absence from the library guide does not fail the self-test.
